requirements.text: Two consent grants made at the same time from different worktrees of one clone are both kept
A vbw command interrupted mid-commit leaves no stray index files in .vbw/runtime and keeps the caller's own exit cleanup
vbw report and vbw rtk do what their help says
In a real session, a documentation requirement is built by the Docs agent and proved
In a real session, QA fails a phase whose build deviates from its plan, and the fix loop closes it
In a real session, /vbw:debug finds the root cause of a seeded bug and fixes it with a regression test
In a real session, /vbw:research returns a sourced answer
In balanced autonomy, a background QA run causes no Stop-hook errors and the session reaches the accept stop
A visual accept check asks the user for a screenshot of the page and keeps it with their verdict

phases.title: Kernel safety: concurrent consent and interrupted commits
phases.goal: The kernel never loses a consent grant and never leaves debris when a command is interrupted.
criteria: A test starts two consent grants at once from two worktrees of one clone, and both grants are in consent.json afterwards.
That test fails on the pre-fix code, and the failure is shown.
A test interrupts a vbw commit mid-way, and .vbw/runtime holds no stray index files afterwards.
A test sets a caller EXIT trap, interrupts the commit, and the caller's trap still runs.
Both tests pass under /bin/bash 3.2 and bash 5, and bash tools/test.sh passes in full.
The kernel is still within 3,000 lines.

phases.title: Honest report and rtk commands
phases.goal: vbw report and vbw rtk behave as their --help text says.
criteria: Each claim in the help text of vbw report and vbw rtk has a test that runs the command and checks the stated outcome.
Where the command and its help disagreed, one was corrected, and a regression test fails without that correction.
The help text and the user docs (docs/) say the same thing about both commands.
bash tools/test.sh passes in full.

phases.title: Balanced autonomy: background QA reaches the accept stop
phases.goal: In balanced autonomy, a background QA run ends cleanly and the session reaches the accept stop.
criteria: An L3 scenario in tools/l3-suite.sh runs balanced autonomy with a background QA run on a named fixture.
The session transcript and debug log hold zero Stop-hook errors during that run.
The record shows the session stopped at the accept stop.
The L3 result names its fixture, its cost and its evidence level.

phases.title: Docs agent builds a documentation requirement
phases.goal: A documentation requirement is built by the Docs agent and proved in a real session.
criteria: An L3 scenario drives /vbw:vibe on a fixture whose spec has one documentation requirement.
The record shows the Docs agent built it, by agent type.
The requirement's check is approved and passes in the record, and the commit carries provenance.
The result is logged with fixture, cost and evidence level.

phases.title: QA fails a deviating build and the fix loop closes it
phases.goal: QA fails a phase whose build deviates from its plan, and the fix loop brings it back to passing.
criteria: An L3 scenario seeds a build that deviates from its plan (a named deviation, e.g. a file the plan requires is missing).
The record shows the QA verdict as fail and names that deviation.
The record shows at least one fix iteration, then a QA verdict of pass.
The phase ends proved, and the number of fix rounds is logged.

phases.title: Debug and research in a real session
phases.goal: /vbw:debug fixes a seeded bug at its root cause with a regression test, and /vbw:research returns a sourced answer.
criteria: An L3 scenario seeds a named bug in a fixture and runs /vbw:debug.
The fix is committed at the seeded root cause, and the diff does not only mask the symptom.
A new regression test is committed, fails on the pre-fix code, and passes after.
An L3 scenario runs /vbw:research on a question with a known answer.
The answer lists at least one source (URL or file path) that a person can open and that supports the answer.
Both results are logged with fixture, cost and evidence level.

phases.title: Visual accept check keeps the user's screenshot
phases.goal: A visual accept check asks the user for a screenshot of the page and stores it with their verdict.
criteria: When a [human] visual check comes up at accept, the prompt asks the user to attach a screenshot, and names the page.
The screenshot file is stored in the project, and the record links it to the check and the user's verdict.
VBW ships no screenshot tool and does not start a browser (decision D1), and a test checks that.
Accepting without a screenshot is refused, or the verdict is recorded as lacking one; the behavior is stated in docs/.
An L3 scenario runs the flow and checks the record. L4 owner acceptance is listed as not done until the owner has done it.

plans.title: Locked consent and interrupt-safe cleanup
tasks: Run tests/kernel-safety.bats on the unfixed code and keep the failing output (R1 lost grants, R2 debris and clobbered caller trap)
Serialize consent_grant read-modify-write (including file creation) with a lock in the clone's git dir shared by all worktrees; no writes outside the project, bash 3.2 safe

Add one cleanup helper in the kernel: signal traps (INT TERM HUP) that remove temp index/record files and the lock then exit promptly, and EXIT handling that chains the caller's existing EXIT trap instead of replacing or clearing it; use it in record_update, record_commit, cmd_commit and vbw_code_tree
Run bash tools/test.sh under /bin/bash and bash 5, confirm the kernel is within 3,000 lines
plans.note: Work committed (1421600d, 86cf81a4) and tests/kernel-safety.bats passes, but vbw check and plan done refuse: contract ee331c3ebdde is not approved (approved was 843599e1a3e3). Re-approve with /vbw:approve, then run vbw plan reset P1.1 / vbw plan done P1.1.

plans.title: Make report and rtk match their help
tasks: Run tests/kernel-diagnostics.bats and note each failing claim
Report: empty counts print none; a corrupt record is reported as corrupt without echoing its content; nothing from spec, code or check output

Verify rtk behavior against RTK's real hook command and install guidance; correct the command or its help line, whichever is wrong, with a regression test in the same file set if new behavior is added
Align the help lines for rtk and report in plugin/bin/vbw with the final behavior and run bash tools/test.sh
plans.note: C3 needs docs/diagnostics.md (test 11 in tests/kernel-diagnostics.bats), outside this plan's files; guard denies writing it. Report fixes (tests 2,4) are committed; rtk already matches its help (tests 7-10 pass), help lines need no change. Add docs/diagnostics.md to the plan: it must contain the help descriptions 'the state of RTK (command-output compression)' and 'diagnostic facts for a bug report about VBW (no spec text or code)', plus the strings 'vbw report' and 'vbw rtk'.

plans.title: Document report and rtk
tasks: Create docs/diagnostics.md with vbw report: what it prints, what it never prints, with the exact help description
Add vbw rtk to it: status output, install hint, hook state, with the exact help description
Link the page from README.md

plans.title: L3 scenario: balanced autonomy with background QA
tasks: Define the named fixture and add scenario_balanced to tools/l3-suite.sh and ALL (balanced autonomy, QA in background, auto on for the session)
Add result writing: tools/l3-results/NAME.json with scenario, fixture, cost_usd, evidence_level L3, at, passed, facts, not_tested; a shared helper others reuse
Check Stop-hook errors in the session transcript and the debug log, and that the record stops at accept; fix any kernel or hook root cause found, as a separate plan if outside these files
Run the scenario for real (about $2-5, D2) and commit the result with facts matching tests/l3-results.bats

plans.title: L3 scenario: Docs agent builds a documentation requirement
tasks: Define the fixture: a spec with one documentation requirement and a check that proves the doc
Add scenario_docs to tools/l3-suite.sh and ALL, driving /vbw:vibe
Assert from the record and subagent transcripts: built by agent type docs, check approved and passing, commit with VBW-Plan trailer
Run it for real and commit the result with fixture, cost, level

plans.title: L3 scenario: QA fails a deviating build, fix loop closes it
tasks: Define the fixture and a seeded deviation (a file the plan requires is missing) that checks alone would not catch
Add scenario_qafix to tools/l3-suite.sh and ALL, seeding the build and driving /vbw:vibe
Assert the first QA verdict fail naming the deviation, at least one fix round, final pass, phase proved; log the round count
Run it for real and commit the result

plans.title: L3 scenarios: debug and research
tasks: Define the debug fixture with a named seeded bug and a known root-cause file; add scenario_debug running /vbw:debug
Assert the fix commit touches the root-cause file, a regression test is committed, fails on the pre-fix tree and passes after, and the diff is not a symptom mask
Define a research question with a known answer; add scenario_research running /vbw:research and assert at least one openable source supporting the answer
Run both for real and commit both results with fixture, cost, level

plans.title: Screenshot with the user's verdict
tasks: Test first in tests/screenshot.bats: req accept ID --screenshot FILE stores the file under .vbw/ and links it in the record to the requirement and verdict; --no-screenshot records its absence; a missing file is refused; plugin/ holds no screenshot tool or browser launch
Implement vbw req accept ID [--screenshot FILE | --no-screenshot] in cmd-req.sh and allow the field in record.jq (kernel stays within 3,000 lines, bash 3.2)
Change the accept step of the vibe skill: for a visual check name the page and ask the user to attach a screenshot; remove the browser-tool and open instructions (D1)
Run bash tools/test.sh

plans.title: L3 scenario: visual accept with a screenshot
tasks: Define a fixture with one [human] visual requirement; add scenario_screenshot to tools/l3-suite.sh and ALL
Drive the accept stop: the prompt names the page and asks for a screenshot; supply a PNG; check the record links file, check and verdict
Run it for real; commit the result with L4 owner acceptance listed in not_tested

plans.title: Document the screenshot accept
tasks: Describe the visual accept flow: the prompt, the user attaches the screenshot, where it is stored
State that accepting without a screenshot needs --no-screenshot and is recorded as lacking one
State decision D1: VBW ships no screenshot tool and starts no browser

decisions.text: R9 screenshots: the user captures and attaches the screenshot; VBW ships no screenshot tool and does not drive a browser for it
decisions.why: owner's choice: simplest, always works, no new dependency; accepted that this is not an automated screenshot

decisions.text: R4-R8 are proved by L3 real-session scenarios, each run after its own phase is built
decisions.why: owner's choice: problems found early; accepted the higher cost of repeated runs (about $2-5 per scenario)

decisions.text: Milestone ships as 2.0.9, one patch release
decisions.why: owner's choice: fixes and proof, no new behavior; one update for users
